messages:
alex: FYI — telemetry alert: tail latency + spike in 5xxs from us-west nodes. Pausing non-critical deploys in today's change window. Deploy-bot, please hold the next two slots. /cc @ops-bot :warning:
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Hold placed by alex on change window 2026-03-21 16:00-18:00. Affected slots: 23, 24. Reason: stability signal (latency spike).
maya: Can we still push the auth hotfix? that's customer-impacting for a few enterprise tenants.
alex: If it's urgent (payments/auth) tag it as 'critical' and ops will triage for emergency slot. Otherwise defer — we don't want to cascade more risk.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Investigating: observed network flaps on us-west infra after recent kernel patch. Correlating with increased p95. ETA ~30m for deeper dig.
sam: Copy. I'll move our model-quantization rollout out of today's window to avoid noise.
jen: I'll update the public calendar + release notes to mark today's rollouts as deferred. Anyone want a short blurb for the incident tracker?
alex: Added a note in #incidents and linked INC-3892. Proposed safety sweep before unfreeze: 1) confirm 5xx back to baseline 2) run a canary against a small subset 3) smoke tests pass. I'll coordinate go/no-go.
maya: For the hotfix: opening an emergency slot request now, PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4123 — labeling it `emergency-deploy` and tagging ops.
alex: Good. If ops gives a green light we can do an emergency slot that bypasses the normal queue, but keep rollback plan and tracing enabled.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Emergency slot request received (PR #4123). Status: pending ops approval. Current hold remains in effect.
sam: Confirmed — I moved our scheduled rollout to 2026-03-22 09:00 in the internal schedule.
jen: Calendar + release notes updated, flagged as deferred. cc @platform for dependency review (any downstream jobs that need reordering?).
ops-bot: ops-bot: Network flap mitigated; 5xx rate down to baseline over the last 10m. Recommend waiting an additional 15m for smoothing, then execute the canary run.
alex: Thanks. Let's run the safety sweep at +20m. I'll post a short go/no-go update once checks finish and then release the hold if green.
maya: Acknowledged. I'll keep the emergency PR prepped with deployment steps and rollback commands.
jen: I'll draft the post-mortem stub so we can capture timeline and impact after we finish.
